title: promote-release.mjs --notes-from <sha>: read release notes from a CHANGELOG-only descendant of the tag commit (DEC-204 (3), used once for 0.14.1)
description: opum-doc DEC-204 (3), ruling A (relay 894). The v0.14.1 tag (peels to 053d8595) has no 0.14.1 heading in CHANGELOG.md, and promote-release.mjs reads release notes at the commit the tag peels to (QCLI-398, QCLI-407), so it would refuse. #632 fixed the heading forward on dev. This adds a narrow --notes-from <sha> so the 0.14.1 promote reads only the ## <version> section at <sha>. The tag, the receipt and the rc bytes stay bound to 053d8595. It is used once for 0.14.1 and the record says so. Sensitive: release tooling; one Opus unit by ref, then the ODOC-484 land on the leader word. The 0.14.1 promote runs from dev checkout whose package.json reads 0.14.1, because promote takes its version from package.json and binds the bundle to the tag peel, not HEAD.

acceptanceCriteria.text: promote-release.mjs --notes-from <sha> accepts a sha only when it descends from the commit the version tag peels to AND its diff against that commit touches CHANGELOG.md alone; it reads only the ## <version> section at <sha>.

A CHANGELOG-only descendant is accepted; a descendant that touches any other file is refused naming that file; a non-descendant is refused by name; each case has a test, and the refusal tests go red when the check is removed.
Without --notes-from the notes are still read at the tag peel commit, unchanged, and the bundle, receipt and rc bytes stay bound to the tag peel when the flag is used.

The PR carries the 0.14.1 promote dry run from the dev tip showing the bundle bound to the 053d8595 peel and the notes taken from the #632 commit, and the release record says the flag is used once, for 0.14.1.

implementationNotes: DEC-204 (3a), opum-doc ruling A (relay 896, via leader 2026-10-20). The files check reads the NET range tag..sha: CHANGELOG.md must be a plain modification and every other file must be under .quest/; anything else is refused by name; B (own diff only) rejected; no version pin. Measured: compare 053d8595...ce33f6d5 lists .quest/tasks/QCLI-499.json and CHANGELOG.md (3 commits, #630 #631 #632), so the CHANGELOG-only check at b1f173c0 refused the one sha it exists for (Opus unit verdict on #634, CHANGES_REQUESTED, claude-opus-5-5). Fix: net-range check allowing .quest/**, sha must be part of dev history (compare dev...sha behind or identical), real-range fixtures (accept ce33f6d5; refuse 053d8595...b1f173c0 naming the code), hand-cut repair hint when --notes-from used, empty --notes-from refused, stale peel text corrected. Mutation: dropping the .quest allowance turned the accept-with-tracker test, the real-range accept and the real-range refusal red (I predicted the first two; the refusal asserts .quest is not blamed, which also fails when the allowance is gone). AC3 real dry run still waits on the pair receipt.
